title: Inflammatory Myopathies in Primary Sjögren's Syndrome
brief_summary: The AMISS study will characterize the features of muscle disease in patients with primary Sjogren's syndrome (pSS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of Primary Sjögren's syndrome according to the ACR/EULAR classification criteria
* inflammatory muscle involvement, as diagnosed by the treating physician

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of inflammatory myopathy before the diagnosis of pSS
